messages:
rachel: Short brief 1 we need final launch assets for the benchmark play: hero (1200x628), three microtiles (1080x1080), story (1080x1920), and a tiny sales sticker (600x314). Deliverables must include: default + a11y-high-contrast + large-type variants, EN + DE language packs, and GIF + MP4 hero animation. Deadline: next Tue EOD.
omar: Copy that. Any A/B headlines?
rachel: Yes 1 A: product-first, B: outcome-first. Keep body the same. Also include one-line social copy and alt-text per asset.
isha: Legal heads-up: avoid flat claims. Use qualifiers like "up to" or add median language. Provide a short methodology line: "based on internal benchmark vs baseline". Looping in @legal-ops.
legal-ops: Confirmed. We need the exact phrasing for translations before sign-off. Any numeric strings must match English approved wording. If you want to claim medians, say "median" explicitly.
megan: Ops note: final assets should be named with timestamp suffix and uploaded to CDN path /assets/bench/2905556667/. Include manifest.csv with filename, alt_text_key, language, and variant. I'll automate the upload once files land.
designbot: Export job queued by rachel: project=figma://redwood/bench id=BK202 frames=[hero,microtile-1,microtile-2,microtile-3,story,sales-sticker] variants=[default,a11y-hc,a11y-large] locales=[en,de] outputs=[png:1200x628,png:1080x1080,png:1080x1920,gif:1200x628,mp4:1200x628,svg]. ETA ~15m.
omear: Small creative ask: hero gif should be a subtle 2s sparkline draw, <2MB. Include static PNG fallback.
isha: Accessibility: high-contrast must hit 4.5:1 for body and 7:1 for small text. Large-type should be min 16px for labels. Provide captions for animated files.
omar: Layer naming convention to keep: frame__variant__lang (e.g., hero__a11y-hc__de). Also include a notes page in Figma with the source line and methodology.
designbot: Export complete. Files placed at /figma/bench/exports/2905556667/: hero_default_en.png, hero_a11y-hc_en.png, hero_a11y-large_de.png, hero_en.gif, hero_en.mp4, microtile-1_default_de.png, sales-sticker_default_en.svg, brand-checklist.pdf. Public preview: https://figma.redwood/exports/2905556667/
megan: I'll pick up upload after legal sign-off. Please attach manifest.csv next to exports with alt-text keys and CTAs.
isha: I'll provide the approved English strings in the localization sheet and flag numeric strings for translation review. Please don't translate the wordings for percentages until we clear with legal.
legal-ops: After we get translations we'll review within 24 hours. For claims we'll require the footnote: "based on internal benchmark vs baseline; methodology in docs." If any partner wants to rephrase, loop us.
omar: Quick QA: visual checklist requested: color hex list, type styles, logo clearspace, and do-not-use tones. Add to the exports as brand-checklist.pdf.
rachel: Perfect. Timeline: design done today, legal review tomorrow midday, upload and CDN deliverables by Monday so sales can prep. Thanks team. :rocket:
megan: Will post upload confirmation once live. Closing this thread unless blockers.
